evals.prompt: node exits with -1073741502 when I run it inside the MXC ProcessContainer, python works fine. why?
evals.expected_output: Identifies 0xC0000142 STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED from the default Win32k block (UiPolicy.Disable=true) preventing user32.dll init, recommends --allow-win32k with its isolation trade-off, and mentions the EPERM lstat C:\ follow-on handled via enumeratePaths

evals.prompt: all my hooks fail with exit 66 when claude runs in MXC
evals.expected_output: Explains Claude Code runs hooks via Git Bash and msys fails NtCreateDirectoryObject 0xC0000022 in BaseContainer, states it is a hard limit, recommends disableAllHooks via a --settings file and testing hook scripts directly

evals.prompt: write me a C# MXC request that runs a tool with only api.anthropic.com reachable and read-only access to C:\tools
evals.expected_output: Uses ContainerRequest with ReadonlyPaths C:\tools, explains there are no hostname allow-lists, uses CIDR egress rules (assigning new lists, not collection initializers) plus DNS or a NetworkProxy, sets ingress deny, and does not grant a drive root

evals.prompt: claude in MXC says Settings file could not be read: Refusing to read a file whose path could not be vetted
evals.expected_output: Attributes it to a deep workspace path with blocked upward traversal and recommends a shallow workspace such as C:\repos\<name>

evals.prompt: mxc run --isolated says Not logged in
evals.expected_output: Explains --isolated has no access to ~/.claude, so auth comes only from a host CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (claude setup-token, set by the user) or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or drop --isolated

evals.prompt: my uv cache writes fail in the MXC sandbox even though I granted a folder under AppData\Local read-write
evals.expected_output: Explains %LOCALAPPDATA% is redirected inside the container so read-write grants there are unwritable, and points to %USERPROFILE%\.mxc-sandbox (MXC_SANDBOX_HOME not under LOCALAPPDATA)

evals.prompt: podman machine start fails with connection refused
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger mxc-troubleshooting: Podman/container engine issue, not Microsoft MXC
